tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals shift to Monday's Stefan Edberg Group as Carlos Alcaraz meets Frances Tiafoe not before 2 p.m. and Daniil Medvedev faces Flavio Cobolli at night, after Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton each opened 1-0 in the McEnroe Group with wins over Rafael Jodar and Arthur Fils • [SQUASH] Joel Makin defended his Pittsburgh Open crown Sunday by rallying from two games down to beat Marwan Elshorbagy 8-11, 9-11, 12-10, 11-5, 11-7, while Malaysia's Sanjay Jeeva upset top seed Alex Lau for the Singapore Classic title • [BADMINTON] Kumamoto Masters Japan closed Sunday with Lakshya Sen's back-to-back Super 500 win over Koki Watanabe and Akane Yamaguchi's home singles triumph, as attention turns to Tuesday's Hong Kong Open and the race for BWF World Tour Finals berths • [PICKLEBALL] Pro qualifying for the Proton Daytona Beach Open runs Monday across 20-plus courts at Pictona from 8 a.m. ET on YouTube, opening a 1,000-point Carvana PPA week with John Lucian Goins chasing a third straight singles title • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Contender Istanbul crowned Fang Bo and Honoka Hashimoto singles champions Sunday before WTT Star Contender Muscat begins Monday with more than 200 players from 37 nations contesting $300,000 in prizes

newsItems.title: Turin Opens With Zverev
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev beat Rafael Jodar 6-4, 6-4 and Ben Shelton edged Arthur Fils 6-2, 3-6, 6-3 to open the Nitto ATP Finals, with Monday's Edberg Group spotlight on Carlos Alcaraz versus Frances Tiafoe in Turin.

newsItems.title: Makin Retakes Pittsburgh
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Joel Makin saved his Pittsburgh Open title Sunday, coming from two games down to beat Marwan Elshorbagy in five after a straight-games semifinal win over Leonel Cardenas at the PSA Silver event.

newsItems.title: Sen Doubles Down
newsItems.excerpt: Lakshya Sen rallied past Koki Watanabe for his second straight BWF title in Kumamoto while Akane Yamaguchi won women's singles on home soil, boosting both ahead of the Hong Kong Open qualifying finale.

newsItems.title: Daytona Qualifiers Start
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Proton Daytona Beach Open begins Monday pro qualifying at Pictona in Holly Hill, streaming on YouTube from 8 a.m. ET as John Lucian Goins pursues a third consecutive singles crown.
